org_ref.name: Park People
org_ref.mission: Park People works to advance city parks as essential spaces to connect people to each other and the rest of nature. They envision a Canada where everyone has access to a vibrant park where people and the rest of nature thrive.
org_ref.description: Park People is the only national, bilingual organization dedicated to championing city parks in Canada. It collaborates with community leaders, non-profit park organizations, and park professionals to realize the potential of urban green spaces for connecting people and nature across the country.

job_ref.title: HR & Admin Coordinator
job_ref.summary_ref: This HR & Admin Coordinator role supports the Finance, Admin, and HR teams at TREC and its clients by managing HR logistics, coordinating recruitment, handling office administration, and assisting with financial tasks, ideally within a non-profit context.

gemini-3.6-flash.mission: Park People supports and mobilizes people to help them activate the power of parks to improve quality of life, social cohesion, equity, and ecological health in cities across Canada.
gemini-3.6-flash.description: Park People is a national bilingual organization dedicated to championing city parks across Canada by supporting local leaders, sharing knowledge, and mobilizing funding to activate green spaces.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.mission: We support a Canadian network of park people by sharing knowledge, connections, and funding, and mobilize Canadians to help city parks meet their full potential.
gemini-3.5-flash-lite.description: Park People is a national, bilingual organization dedicated to supporting and mobilizing people to activate the power of city parks across Canada, enhancing community life and green spaces.

groq.mission: We support a Canadian network of park people by sharing knowledge, connections and funding that bolsters their awesome work in parks We also mobilize Canadians by highlighting the insights, policies and practices that help city parks meet their full potential.
groq.description: Park People is the only national, bilingual organization solely dedicated to championing city parks in Canada. We support a Canadian network of park people by sharing knowledge, connections and funding that bolsters their awesome work in parks.
